title: HS30103: Economics Of Health
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsIntroduction and Overview; Supply and Demand:
The Production of Health; Importance of Prices in the Medical Sector; Demand
for Medical Care: Theory and Empirical Evidence; Economics of Health Insurance:
Conventional and New Insurance Theory; Organisation of Health Insurance
Providers: Health Insurance Markets, Managed Care, Non-Profit Firms; The
Private Health Insurance Industry; Hospitals: Production Functions, Cost
Theory, Efficiency; Industry Organization and The Theory of Non-Profits;
Physicians: Payments, Costs and Induced Demand; Licensure, Advertising and
Price Discrimination; Small Area Variation, Specialization; Labor Market
Issues: Shortages, Surpluses, Monopsony and the Shortage of Nurses; The
Pharmaceutical Industry; Government Intervention and Regulation; Government As
Health Insurer; Epidemiology and Economics; The Market For Long-Term Care;
Cost-Effectiveness Analysis in Health Care; International Comparisons.
